name: nh3h2o_absorption_precooler
title: Single-stage ammonia-water absorption cycle with a condensate precooler
summary: Single-stage NH3H2O absorption refrigeration cycle, Herold, Radermacher and Klein Example 9.3: the condensed refrigerant (10) is subcooled in the condensate precooler (capacity-rate effectiveness model) by the cold evaporator outlet (13/14). Given the heat rejection temperatures (40 C), the evaporator temperature (-10 C) and the design goals (x[9] = 0.9996, DELTAx = 0.1), the model computes the 14 state points, the component heat rates and the COP.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)
PROCEDURE shx (kept; Min() = smaller of two capacity rates)

origin.notes: Example 9.3 of Herold, Radermacher and Klein, Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2015; EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/). The .eez companion stores the binary .EES with the solution used as verification reference. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples.

verification.summary: The native file was solved in CoolSolve and compared with the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py --ees-units, 122 common variables): COP within 1.8 %, heat rates within 4.2 %, pressures within 0.11 %, temperatures within 2.8 %, mass fractions within 3.5 %. Whole-cycle balance closes to 8e-7 W. Deviations explained by the NH3H2O property backend (bubble composition at identical inputs differs 2.6 %).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the binary Ex9_3.EES inside ex9_3.eez (ees_variables.csv), compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: Compared set: 122 common variables. Excluded: h[i], s[i] (absolute NH3H2O enthalpy/entropy, different reference state in EES and CoolProp; the EES s[1..14] and v[2..14] records are stale, the file computes none of them), checkQ (balance residual: EES 3.6e-03 W, CoolSolve -7.9e-07 W on 470 kW), cp_1011/cp_1314 (reference units J/g-K not converted by --ees-units, CS-BUG-COMPARE-JGK; true diffs 5.4e-03 and 8.3e-03). Max kept rel diff as printed: DELTAt_glide 5.46e-02 (absolute 0.021 K on a 0.36 K glide); Q_dot_shx 4.11e-02; x[4] 3.42e-02; COP_1 1.77e-02. Q[6] and Q[14] agree exactly (boundary clamp values -0.001/1.001 in both tools).
